Setsuna Tokage (Provisional License).name: Setsuna Tokage (Provisional License)
Setsuna Tokage (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Setsuna Tokage, hero name Lizardy, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and may now act as a hero in an emergency. Loose moss-green hair, a sharp-toothed grin; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Fast, chatty, teasing; candid opinions nobody asked for.
Combat Role: Scout and harrier: wide scatters for search, distraction and capture.
Under Pressure: Improvises aloud and keeps a scout piece on the exit.
Setsuna Tokage (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer showed her real danger, and she answers it with chatter over sharper planning. Motivation: Prove her Quirk is a search-and-rescue tool, not a party trick. Concealment: Worry kept behind jokes. Canon voice & behavior: Teases an opponent while she circles them; narrates a search out loud for her teammates. Thread: What a licensed scout does when nobody is giving the orders.
QUIRK: Lizard Tail Splitter; wide, long-held scatters.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed, with all of 1-B.
personality: Chatterbox: Keeps the 1-B dorm lively and talks classmates through their nerves.
Playful: Turns a drill into a game with a running score.
Careful underneath: Scouts her riskiest assumption before she commits.
Speaking style: Lively, direct banter and quick instructions; talks fast, laughs easily, thinks out loud.
abilities: Body division: Splits into as many as fifty floating pieces; a piece caught or hit is her caught or hit.
Search sweep: Spreads pieces through rubble or a crowd to find the missing; each piece sees only what is in front of it.
Multiple angles: Pieces distract, surround or pin a target; more distraction than damage.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency; not yet a full license.
Fighting style: Scatters early, scouts while she talks and strikes from the unwatched angle, setting up teammates' captures.
Setsuna Tokage (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with loose moss-green hair parted at the center, bright green eyes, fair skin and a medium build. Her wide grin shows a row of small, sharp pointed teeth. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Confident, easy grin.
